node.label: odontoleukodystrophy
node.definition: A leukodystrophy characterized by progressive ataxia beginning during infancy, a pyramidal syndrome and dental agenesis. The syndrome has been described in four children born to consanguineous parents. The mode of transmission is autosomal recessive.
